slides.title: Manufacturing Industry Context
slides.task_brief: Industry context slide. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT · MANUFACTURING' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'Manufacturing is converging physical operations with digital intelligence.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Connected operations, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility and quality at scale define the modern factory.'. Below subtitle: a TWO-COLUMN layout. LEFT column (55% width): a .surface-elev panel (~560px x 360px) titled 'WHY MANUFACTURING NEEDS THIS NOW' (eyebrow in --brand). Below, a stacked list of 4 industry drivers, each as a small .surface card with: Material Icon (20px) in --brand + Sora 600 driver title (13px) + Inter 11px --text-secondary description. Verbatim drivers — 'precision_manufacturing' 'Industry 4.0 convergence' / 'OT/IT convergence accelerating — ISA-95, OPC UA, MTConnect connecting factory floor to cloud.' 'shield' 'IEC 62443 cybersecurity mandate' / 'OT security now regulated — IEC 62443-3-3 SL2 compliance required for connected factories.' 'speed' 'OEE optimisation pressure' / 'Overall Equipment Effectiveness targets rising — predictive maintenance and real-time quality data now baseline.' 'local_shipping' 'Supply chain resilience' / 'Multi-echelon visibility, supplier risk monitoring, and demand forecasting now critical for continuity.' RIGHT column (45% width): a .surface-elev panel (~440px x 360px) titled 'WHAT THIS MEANS FOR DATA ANALYTICS & DATA ENGINEERING' (eyebrow in --accent-dark). Below, Inter 13px --text-secondary body text (line-height 1.7): 'Data Analytics & Data Engineering applied to manufacturing requires OT-aware, ISA-95 aligned, IEC 62443 compliant capability — not generic technology. The right approach connects data analytics & data engineering to equipment protocols (OPC UA, MTConnect, Profinet), plant systems (Siemens Opcenter, SAP S/4HANA, Ignition), and the operational realities of the factory floor.' Below body: a small .tag-pill 'OT-AWARE · ISA-95 ALIGNED · IEC 62443' in --brand-soft. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '02 / 12'; right 'MANUFACTURING CONTEXT'.

Below subtitle: a horizontal lifecycle flow diagram (~1136px x 90px) showing 4 stages as connected .surface cards with ► arrow separators in --accent. Below the lifecycle flow: a 3-column x 2-row grid of SIX compact capability pillar cards (each ~365px wide x ~120px tall, gap-3). Each card: top row — Material Icon (24px) in --brand on left + JetBrains Mono num ('01'-'06') in --accent on right; below — Sora 600 pillar name (14px) in --primary + Inter 11px --text-secondary description (2 lines). Verbatim pillars — 1 'ISA-95 data governance, sensor data quality, ISA-88 batch data lineage.' 'Data Strategy & Governance' / 'lightbulb' 2 'Kafka + AWS IoT SiteWise pipelines, SAP MII ERP-MES integration, OPC UA ingestion.' 'Data Engineering & Integration' / 'storage' 3 'Databricks Lakehouse, Azure Digital Twins, cloud-native historian (InfluxDB).' 'Data Platforms & Modernization' / 'cloud' 4 'Real-time OEE dashboards, plant manager cockpits, ISO 50001 energy analytics.' slides.title: Engagement Pathway
slides.task_brief: Engagement pathway slide. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'A four-stage pathway from discovery to managed operations.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Each stage carries concrete deliverables, a fixed duration, and a transparent commercial frame.' 4-column grid of FOUR .pathway-stage cards (each ~270px wide x ~360px tall, gap-4). Apply .pathway-stage.accent to card 4. Each card: .pathway-stage-num + .pathway-stage-name + .pathway-stage-meta + hairline-soft + 'DELIVERABLES' eyebrow + deliverables list + .pathway-stage-fee. Verbatim — STAGE 01 'Discovery' meta '2 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Data Analytics & Data Engineering maturity assessment', 'OT/IT landscape mapping', 'ISA-95 gap analysis', '90-day roadmap'. Fee: '$25K-$75K'. STAGE 02 'Solution Design' meta '3-4 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Target architecture (OT/IT)', 'IEC 62443 security design', 'Platform selection', 'Build plan'. Fee: '$50K-$150K'. STAGE 03 'Delivery' meta '8-24 WEEKS · T&M OR FIXED'. Deliverables: 'Production system', 'OT/IT integration', 'IEC 62443 validation', 'Knowledge transfer'. Fee: '$300K-$1M'. STAGE 04 'Managed Operations' meta 'ONGOING · RETAINER'. Deliverables: 'Managed services (OT-aware)', 'Continuous optimization', 'Quarterly reviews', 'SLA-backed operations'. Fee: '$50K-$500K / mo'. NO .pull-quote. NO CTA button. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '10 / 12'; right 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY'.
